decision.title: Prologs: the static context, declared functions and variables (packet )
decision.summary: The XQuery prolog is read into one sxml_xpath_static_context; declared functions become one IR function per arity, and variables become initializer functions computed in dependency order, only when reached.

body.p: , completing and for XQuery main modules. src/xquery_static.c (src/xquery_static_internal.h) reads the prolog into one sxml_xpath_static_context; src/xquery_prolog.c lowers the module and now holds sxml_xquery_lower / sxml_xquery_compile (moved from src/xquery_lower.c); src/evaluator_global.c computes globals. No new IR kind, no header change, no machinery beside the core's.

item.p: Static context: namespace declarations and the default element namespace (prefix 0) first, then the host's bindings, then local and output (XQuery predeclares them); variables: the host's, then the prolog's (global n); a function table finds declared functions, then the host's table. Duplicates are found by sorting (XQST0033, XQST0049 also against host declarations, XQST0034 for overlapping arity ranges); setters and the context value declaration at most once (XQST0068, 0038, 0032, 0067, 0065, 0069, 0055, 0099); XQST0070, XQST0066, XQST0039, XQST0148, XQST0045 (function names and annotations in reserved namespaces, the XQuery namespace for unprefixed annotations; so %updating is rejected, ), XQST0106/XQST0116, XQST0009 (schema import, ), XQST0038 (unsupported default collation). External functions are XPST0017. Module imports and item type/record declarations are UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE for now.

Unprefixed function names (5.14.2): the core resolves them to fn and looks names up without interning, so the prolog interns fn:L for every unprefixed call/reference name when it declares a no-namespace function or a default function namespace; the table then tries the declared no-namespace L (or L in the default function namespace, also among library functions: pi() under the math namespace) before fn:L. A written fn:L finds the same (Proposed: a default function namespace in the XPath static context).

Declared functions: one IR function per arity of the arity range, added to the unit before any body is lowered (recursion and mutual recursion are STATIC_CALLs on the evaluator's stack, ); the full arity holds the body with its result COERCEd; a shorter arity binds the missing defaults (coerced, no focus) and calls the full one; := . is SXML_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_VALUE, which the core supplies at the call. Bodies are level-0 functions with an absent focus.

Variables and the context value: each value or default is an initializer IR function of arity 0, coerced to the declared type. When the prolog has initializers or a context value declaration, the unit gets the context global (name 0, the last global; glossary) and the query body and every variable initializer read the focus as the fixed focus of it (5.17); the main function's focus slot receives the host's context value, which the global part copies (coerced) into the context global unless a non-external declaration gives the value.

Computation order: after lowering, the expression, atom and map entry runs each body and initializer added are scanned for globals read and declared functions called or referenced; an iterative walk from the query body orders the reached variables dependencies first; a cycle through a variable is XQDY0054, raised at compile time (5.16 allows static detection). Reached variables get, in that order, an initializer that calls their lowered one; the global part sorts the variables to compute by initializer index and runs each as a CALL on the machine (a pushed task turned into a CALL, as the machine's static calls are), so unreached variables are never computed (declare variable $x := 1 div 0; 2 is 2); BEING_COMPUTED still gives XQDY0054 for dynamic cycles.

Rejected: computing on first read (needs every atom read in the machine to suspend: a change across src/evaluator.c); relowering in dependency order (two lowerings; the extra initializers cost one call).

Later additions (same packet): named item types are aliases in the XPath static context (named_item_types, sxml_xpath_find_named_type, also for cast targets; resolved in rounds, so forward references work) with a cast as constructor function for generalized atomic types; records are nominative registry types (reused when an earlier compilation for the item heap declared the name) with a constructor IR function (a map of the fields, %static fields' defaults, coerced to the record); the QT4 tests call constructors of records without %constructor, so every record gets one. Decimal formats (XQST0111, XQST0114, XQST0097 for a value's form, XQST0098 otherwise) and the default collation go into unit_static_context (), which the module entry copies into the unit. sxml_xpath_static_context gets a function namespace rule (fn; a declared default; no namespace first, which the XQuery table falls back from to fn), replacing the interning workaround above; an empty namespace declaration binds the prefix to no namespace, which the core reads as undeclared (the lowerer accepts it); xq is predeclared; annotations of inline functions and function types are checked (XQST0045, XQST0125). Output declarations are checked by name (XQST0109, XQST0110); their values are 3.12's to read.
